meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 benchling-sdk 和 v2 API 操作 Benchling 平台,管理序列、库存、实验记录等数据,并支持工作流、事件集成、数据仓库查询等自动化功能。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据时触发。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到位置 box_xyz789。
say.note: 执行库存转移,更新容器位置。

say.text: 查询数据仓库中最近一周的上样量汇总。
say.note: 运行 SQL 查询并返回汇总结果。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use benchling-sdk and the v2 API to operate on Benchling, managing data such as sequences, inventory, and ELN entries, and supporting workflows, event integrations, and Data Warehouse queries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to automate lab data using benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

say_en.text: Create a circular DNA sequence pET28a with bases ATCGATCG using benchling-sdk.
say_en.note: Creates a new entity in Benchling's registry.

say_en.text: Move container cont_abc123 to location box_xyz789.
Query the Data Warehouse for sample loading totals from the past week.
say_en.note: Runs an SQL query and returns the summary.
